Biryar has two plans. **Free sees, Pro acts**: on the free plan you see
everything Biryar would do; Pro does it.

| | Free | Pro |
|---|---|---|
| Portfolio, profit, invoice reading | Everything | Everything |
| Sourcing: every retailer | Yes | Yes |
| Retailers in one scan | Up to 3 | No limit |
| Scans a day | 2 | No limit |
| Results shown per scan | The best 100 | All of them |
| Retailers kept running on a schedule | No | Yes |
| Adding a retailer of your own | No | Yes |
| Repricing: every decision, explained and checked with Amazon | Yes, as a preview | Yes |
| Prices sent to Amazon, on a schedule you set | No | Yes |

Pro is **€29 a month or €290 a year**.

## Why the line is there

It is drawn between being told and having it done, not between shops
and not between markets. Every retailer is on both plans. A shop that
needs a scraping account needs one on either plan, and Biryar does not
charge again for a service you already pay for.

Nothing about the repricer is limited by number on the free plan. Not
sending prices *is* the limit.

## The free trial

Every business can try Pro for fourteen days, once, with no card: under
**Settings, Plan**, choose *Try Pro free*. When it ends, the free plan
carries on with everything you have.

## A licence

A Pro licence is one line of text, sent to you by email after you buy it at
<https://biryar.ciyalabs.com/get/>. Paste it under **Settings, Plan**.

It is checked on your machine, by its signature: nothing is sent anywhere
to check it, so Biryar keeps working on a laptop without a connection,
and a licence server being down can never switch your repricer off.

## When Pro ends

Nothing is deleted. Your listings, decisions, scans, results, beliefs and
schedules all stay. What stops is what Pro does: prices are no longer sent,
scheduled scans and passes stop, and scans return to the free limits. A
renewed licence picks up exactly where it left off. Results a free scan
held back appear as soon as you are on Pro again.
